key_observations: EARLY TERMINATION UNDERMINES DIAGNOSIS: The run completed only 844/3000 iterations (28%). Domain Rule 11 explicitly prohibits drawing conclusions from <1000 iterations. The stability gate failure is real, but the diagnostic question — does the baseline structurally fail or just spike early? — cannot be answered from this truncated run.

FELL_OVER SLOPE IS NEGATIVE: fell_over trended from 0.0 → 1.583 at last reading, but the slope is -0.00118/iter (declining). Domain Rule 2 says only treat sustained fell_over > 1.5 PAST iteration ~750 as a stability failure. At iter 844 the run has barely crossed that threshold, and the trend is moving in the right direction. Linear extrapolation suggests fell_over could reach ~0.4 by iteration ~1800 if the decline holds.

EPISODE LENGTH IS A STRONG POSITIVE SIGNAL: mean_ep_len grew from 12.6 → 858 steps with a positive slope. The per-step reward rate (mean_reward / mean_ep_len) went from -0.031 to +0.057 — clearly improving. The robot is surviving dramatically longer, which is the primary locomotion prerequisite.

GAIT CONTACT IRREGULARITY IS THE MOST CONCERNING GAIT METRIC: gait_contact_cv_mean = 0.602 (well above the 0.40 irregular threshold), and its slope is positive (+0.000047/iter — worsening). By contrast, gait_air_cv_mean = 0.296 (acceptable). This asymmetry points to irregular stance timing (possibly limping) rather than swing-phase issues. The mirror-pose limp signature is also present: symmetry_pos_cost (0.011) is small but symmetry_vel_cost (0.068) is relatively large.

EXPLORATION IS HEALTHY, NOT COLLAPSED: entropy declined from 28.3 → 17.3 (61% of start), well above the 30% collapse threshold of Domain Rule 3. action_std at 0.58 is still above the healthy endpoint band of 0.2–0.4, consistent with a policy still actively exploring at 844 iterations.

VELOCITY TRACKING AND LANDING FORCE ARE BOTH GOOD: track_linear_velocity = 1.244, velocity tracking score = 0.909. landing_force_mean = 40.3 N — in the healthy 30–90 N range. These components are not the problem.

THIS IS THE FOURTH CONSECUTIVE STABILITY FAILURE INCLUDING THE ORIGINAL BASELINE: even with air_time_reward_weight restored to 0.2, fell_over remains elevated. However, because this run was cut at 28% completion with a declining fell_over slope, we cannot yet conclude that structural instability (curriculum/reset configuration) is confirmed — the run was never given the chance to demonstrate whether it would stabilize past iteration 1000.
next_suggestion: Re-run this exact baseline configuration for the full 3000 iterations before declaring structural instability. The negative fell_over slope and rapidly growing episode length are the strongest signal available and they are both positive — the run was cut before the natural early-spike resolved. If the full run still shows fell_over > 0.5 sustained past iteration 1000, THEN the diagnosis of structural instability is confirmed and the next lever is the curriculum velocity ramp: specifically, reduce the rate at which lin_vel_x_max advances (e.g. slow the curriculum to extend the low-speed phase from ~500 to ~1000 iterations), and optionally reduce reset randomization magnitude. Count these as one semantic change per Domain Rule 12.
